title: Personal automation and a maintained company service are different
text: Shipper describes moving from personal agents toward agents responsible for team or company jobs, with continuing engineering and maintenance. This offers a concrete explanation for why an individual’s useful experiment still needs a service owner, shared context and ongoing support before others rely on it.
qualification: First-party account from Every; neither a representative enterprise sample nor a guaranteed scale-up pattern.
